entries.name: โลกจริงหลุดบท
entries.identity: Creative entertainment, surreal concepts and imaginative reinterpretations.
entries.rules: Original visual entertainment and fictional mini-stories. Hypothetical game interpretations belong here and must be clearly labeled unofficial concepts, never official adaptations. No copied artwork, actor likenesses, logos or unsupported affiliation. Disclose fiction and distinguish any sourced public premise from invented mechanics. Language and audience follow the concept; no forced speech. Existing Reel authority remains separate and unchanged.

entries.name: ร้อยละคนไทย
entries.identity: Thai-interest topics, current entertainment, trends and thoughtful discussion.
entries.rules: For trends verify the topic, date and original public source. Distinguish confirmed facts, allegations, rumors and commentary; do not invent popularity, events, quotes or the owner's personal opinion. No defamatory speculation or private-person targeting. Attribute sources and flag spoilers. Write something worth reading without an image, not generic summaries. Illustrate with original visuals only; no copied articles, official posters, actor likenesses or unlicensed footage. Hypothetical games and surreal fiction belong to the creative Page instead.

entries.name: แก้บัคยาวๆๆ
entries.identity: Development, technology, programming and useful real engineering problems.
entries.rules: Follow PAGE_A_CREATIVE_PLAYBOOK.md: useful audience-facing technical explanations, practical comparisons and real debugging/workflow lessons; never an internal release/QA feed. Verify factual claims against primary documentation; distinguish tested behavior from a proposal or untested hypothesis. Never invent personal experience. Natural accessible Thai with familiar technical terms, restrained humor, no decorative emojis or engagement bait, two to three relevant hashtags. Image publication remains disabled; preparation never grants publication.
